title: rec notes
description: {base}.notes.v1.json beside the recording's parts. Final notes — after every change to them: a pass, an edit, a deletion — also go to the recording's Drive or iCloud folder as {base}.notes.json, the same JSON, with the folder's notesAt; a local folder keeps them on the device. See docs/recly.md §8 "Organizing" and §3 "Drive layout".

stage.description: provisional: made while recording, part by part; final: made after Stop from the recording's transcript.

overview.description: Three to five sentences over the whole recording; final notes only. The user's words once overviewEditedAt is set.

tombstones.description: Items the user deleted; an item that matches one is never shown again.

section.description: The id of the user's section a deleted section item was in.

conversations.description: The final pass's conversations in order, each with its summary when it had enough words to be asked about.

parts.description: The part numbers the provisional pass is done with, notes or not.

model.description: The ChatGPT model the notes were last made with.

modelName.description: The plan's name for model (`GPT-5.4`), shown under the notes.

sections.description: The user's own sections (Settings → ChatGPT → My sections) the notes were made with, in order: up to three from Settings, plus an earlier one still holding an item the user edited — so the list itself is not capped.

description.description: What goes in it, as the user wrote it; may be empty.

overviewEditedAt.description: When the user last changed the overview in Edit notes; from then on the overview stays theirs.

kind.description: point: a key point, made after Stop only; section: an item of one of the user's own sections, named by the item's section.

text.description: What the model wrote, which matching goes by; the user's words are userText.

owner.description: The speaker id of the transcript the item was made from, for a to-do: the recording's for a final item, the part's own for a provisional one. Never a name.

due.description: The deadline as it was said.

quote.description: Words of the transcript near atSec, verbatim (checked on the device).

conversation.description: The index of a final item's conversation.

section.description: The id of the user's section a section item is in.

userText.description: The user's words for the item from Edit notes, shown instead of text.

editedAt.description: When the user last edited the item; an edited item stays theirs.
